categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in textile manufacturing, focusing on cotton yarn (comber yarn) and fabric production. It also engages in forestry, import-export, real estate leasing, and investment activities, though the core revenue is from textile products. The textile segment accounts for over 99% of total sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses advanced spinning technology and state-of-the-art production facilities located in Iksan and Pyeongdong plants. It imports raw cotton from countries like the USA, Brazil, and Australia and processes it into high-quality yarn and fabrics. The company emphasizes quality control, productivity improvement, and cost reduction in its manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic wholesalers, distributors, and end-users in the textile and apparel industries, as well as foreign importers through export channels. The products serve the knitwear industry and are also used in various applications including clothing, lifestyle goods, and automotive interior materials. The company sells both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities in Iksan, Pyeongdong, Yeongam, and Gwangju. It imports raw materials globally from the USA, Brazil, and Australia and exports products to international markets. The domestic market remains a significant portion of sales, but exports also contribute substantially.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on spinning raw cotton into yarn and fabric production. It relies on imported raw cotton as an upstream input and supplies yarn and fabric downstream to apparel manufacturers and other industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing new functional and blended yarn products, including rayon slub and cotton/polyester slub yarns. R&D efforts target premium denim products with functional materials such as cooling and heating fibers. The strategic priorities include quality enhancement, productivity improvement, cost reduction, and exploring new markets to overcome structural industry challenges.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of textile products, including yarn and fabrics, both domestically and internationally. The company also earns minor income from leasing activities. Sales are conducted via direct sales, export contracts using L/C and T/T payment methods, and domestic wholesale channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from major cotton yarn producers in India and China, who have improved cost efficiency and quality through new spinning machinery and better raw cotton quality. To maintain competitiveness, the company emphasizes diversification of raw materials, production efficiency, and product quality stabilization. It holds a significant position in the Korean textile industry but faces challenges from global competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 94.8 billion KRW with an operating loss of 32.5 billion KRW and a net loss of 19.2 billion KRW, reflecting a decline from previous years due to adverse market conditions. Total assets stood at about 237 billion KRW with equity of approximately 190 billion KRW. The company has experienced a downward growth trajectory recently due to rising raw material costs, inflation, and reduced domestic and global demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality cotton yarn and fabric products produced with advanced spinning technology and stringent quality control. It differentiates itself through the development of functional and premium textile products tailored to evolving consumer needs, including eco-friendly and performance-enhanced materials. The focus on stable supply, product innovation, and customer responsiveness underpins its value proposition.
